detail.title: Run claim-epoch release conformance and NEEDLE consumer canary (BR-T27)
Create dependent beads atomically without a dispatchable intermediate state

detail.reason:
Shipped as 3f31eee on origin/main (bead-rs). A dependent bead is now created with its gating graph inside one transaction, so it never appears on the ready frontier before its dependencies exist.

Native path: `bead create --depends-on BLOCKER` (repeatable) validates and attaches `blocks` edges inside the create transaction. Missing blocker exits 3, self-edge and cycle exit 4, and each rolls the create back so no issue and no edge is minted. A `--unique-ref` replay never mutates the existing bead's graph. The wider case stays on `bead manifest commit`, now documented as the required planner workflow in `bead create --help`, `bead manifest commit --help`, and research/specs/bulk-manifests-v1.md ("Planning dependent graphs"), which also states the new finding that replay safety requires a unique_ref on EVERY create in a plan.

Acceptance evidence, tests/atomic_dependent_creation.rs (9 fixtures, all passing; 8/8 clean repeat runs):
- Concurrent claimer: two claimer threads on their own WAL connections pull the frontier continuously while a dependent create + dep_add is held open in flight, then commit. Zero wins on the dependent bead, and the claimers' non-empty win set proves the assertion is not vacuous. A priority-inverted binary fixture (dependent P0 gated on a P4 blocker) confirms the frontier serves only the blocker until it closes.
- Cycle and missing-ID rollback: cyclical manifest, self-edge manifest, `--depends-on` on a nonexistent ID, and a manifest dep_add on a nonexistent ID all refuse with the issue count, edge count and checkpoint bytes unchanged.
- Idempotent unique-reference replay: a byte-identical replay reports outcome "existing" for the referenced create and "no-op" for the edge, semantic_changes 0, and publishes no generation (checkpoint files and generation pointer byte-identical).
- Resource keys at first visibility: keys declared alongside the dependent create are present on the bead at the first read after commit, with the gating edge already in place.
- Checkpoint/audit parity: the published generation covers the whole event span (covered_sequence == live_sequence, ready_to_commit true), names both ends of the edge, and carries exactly two create events plus one dependency_added event.

A deliberate negative control (`two_separate_commands_leave_a_claimable_intermediate`) records that the create-then-dep composition really does leave the claimable intermediate behind, so the guards are known to detect the hazard.

Note on the shared tree: src/cli.rs and src/main.rs were already dirty with the in-flight claim-epoch work (BR-T23..T26) before this dispatch, so committing those files necessarily carried those hunks; they were coherent, compiled, and every suite touched passes (atomic_dependent_creation 9/9, r033_bulk_manifests 9/9, r031_resource_locks 3/3, cli_claim 11/11, r002_leased_claims 12/12). fmt clean on all four committed paths; clippy clean for the new test target.

Shipped and repaired: dependent-create is atomic, and origin/main compiles again.

FEATURE (3f31eee, verified): `bead create --depends-on BLOCKER` (repeatable) validates and attaches `blocks` edges inside the create transaction, so a missing blocker (exit 3), a self-edge or a cycle (exit 4) rolls the create back and the issue never reaches the ready frontier ahead of its graph. `bead manifest commit` is documented as the planner path for wider graphs. Guidance in `bead create --help`, `bead manifest commit --help`, and research/specs/bulk-manifests-v1.md. tests/atomic_dependent_creation.rs: 9/9 pass from a clean `git archive` extraction with no rival WIP in the build, covering the never-claimable invariant, the two-command negative control, concurrent claimers observing zero wins, cycle/self-edge/missing-ID rollback, idempotent unique-ref replay with no second generation, resource keys at first visibility, and checkpoint/audit parity.

REPAIR (4856226, pushed 10:15:13Z): 3f31eee did not compile. It carried the CLI surface of an unrelated uncommitted claim-epoch feature (`--override-claim`, `claim_epoch`, `*_with_override`) without that feature's library half - 14 type errors on a fresh clone. Rebased both files onto 3f31eee^ and re-applied only the depends-on changes; the claim-epoch work is left uncommitted for the beads that own it. Verified 9/9 from a clean `git archive 4856226` extraction whose src tree is byte-identical to the pushed HEAD.

Note: the earlier close of this bead at 09:46:50Z was bounced by the gate before the compile breakage was known; that bounce was correct in substance.
